tickets.title: SQL Injection in ApexLoan Mortgage Underwriting API Endpoint
tickets.description: Checkmarx SAST scan and manual verification confirmed unsanitized user parameter in dynamic PostgreSQL query construction inside `CreditUnderwritingService.java` line 142. Allows unauthenticated extraction of applicant credit bureau scores and SSNs.

findingDetails.vulnerabilityTitle: SQL Injection in Mortgage Assessment Filter
findingDetails.cweName: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
findingDetails.proofOfConcept:
POST /api/v2/underwriting/assessments/query
Content-Type: application/json

{"applicantTaxId": "999-00-1111' OR 1=1; --"}

Returns unauthenticated full customer database records.
findingDetails.remediationRecommendation: Replace dynamic raw SQL string interpolation with parameterized queries using Spring Data JPA `PreparedStatement` or named query parameters.
findingDetails.compensatingControls: Imperva WAF rule 942100 active in blocking mode for SQLi on `/api/v2/underwriting/*`.

tickets.title: Distributed Credential Stuffing Attack Against ApexOnline Web Banking Login
tickets.description: Splunk SIEM correlation alert detected 48,000 failed authentication attempts per minute originating from 1,200 residential proxy nodes in Eastern Europe targeting retail customer accounts.

incidentDetails.containmentActions: Enforced rate limiting at Cloudflare / Palo Alto edge WAF (max 3 attempts/min per IP subnet). Enabled mandatory reCAPTCHA Enterprise and forced out-of-band push MFA on all suspicious logins.
incidentDetails.eradicationActions: Identified 14 compromised accounts and automatically invalidated active OAuth sessions and triggered self-service password reset flows with biometric re-verification.

tickets.title: OpenSSL Remote Code Execution (RCE) on Core Payment Kubernetes Nodes
tickets.description: Trivy infrastructure container vulnerability scan identified CVE-2026-21894 in Alpine base images hosting the Core Banking Switch payment processing microservice.

findingDetails.cweName: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
findingDetails.remediationRecommendation: Update base Docker image to Alpine 3.19.2 containing openssl >= 3.0.13-r0 and redeploy pods via ArgoCD rolling upgrade.

tickets.title: Exception: Delayed TLS 1.3 Cipher Suite Migration on Legacy SWIFT Bastion
tickets.description: Requesting 90-day extension to maintain TLS 1.2 CBC cipher suites for legacy SWIFT Alliance Access partner node pending scheduled Q4 hardware crypto card firmware overhaul.

exceptionDetails.requestedControlName: Mandatory TLS 1.3 / Deprecation of Legacy CBC Ciphers
exceptionDetails.reason: Legacy SWIFT partner gateway HSM firmware v4.2 does not support TLS 1.3 without vendor kernel rebuild scheduled for Oct 2026.
exceptionDetails.businessJustification: Premature deprecation will halt international correspondent bank settlement wires exceeding $450M daily volume.
exceptionDetails.compensatingControls: Dedicated IPSec GRE tunnel with AES-256-GCM encryption between bank DMZ and SWIFT network; MAC address IP locking; 24/7 dedicated SOC alert on TLS renegotiation attempts.

comments.content: Confirmed vulnerability via manual Burp Suite test on staging. The dynamic query in `UnderwritingRepository.java` bypasses ORM mapping. Understood. We have written a hotfix using JPA CriteriaBuilder with parameterized predicates. Branch `hotfix/underwriting-sqli-cve-2026-90412` is building in GitLab CI now. We will submit for AppSec retest as soon as unit tests finish.

kbArticles.title: Incident Response Playbook: Endpoint & Server Ransomware Containment (SOP-SOC-04)
kbArticles.summary: Step-by-step emergency procedures for isolating infected endpoints, preserving volatile memory, revoking domain tokens, and notifying the Executive Incident Team.
kbArticles.contentMarkdown:
## Phase 1: Immediate Network Isolation (0 - 15 Minutes)
1. **CrowdStrike EDR Network Containment**: Trigger host isolation immediately via Falcon console.
2. **Switch Port Shutdown**: If EDR agent is unresponsive, execute emergency Cisco Catalyst port shutdown via Network Ops.
3. **Domain Token Revocation**: Revoke Kerberos TGT tickets and disable Active Directory computer account.

## Phase 2: Volatile Memory & Forensic Artifacts (15 - 60 Minutes)
- Capture live RAM dump via WinPmem / LiME before system reboot.
- Export Windows Security Event Log (IDs 4624, 4625, 4688, 7045, 1102).

## Phase 3: Central Bank Notification Trigger
If ransomware involves encrypted financial or customer databases, the CISO must notify the Central Bank Financial Cyber Directorate within 24 hours.

kbArticles.title: GRC Standard Operating Procedure: Requesting and Managing Security Policy Exceptions
kbArticles.summary: Criteria, mandatory compensating controls, risk ownership thresholds, and renewal limits for bank information security policy exemptions.
kbArticles.contentMarkdown:
## Eligibility Criteria
Security policy exceptions may only be requested when immediate remediation introduces unacceptable operational disruption to critical payment flows or when vendor dependencies prevent compliance within the standard SLA window.

### Mandatory Requirements:
1. Identified and tested **Compensating Control** that reduces residual risk score to MEDIUM or LOW.
2. Endorsement by **Division Head / Application Owner**.
3. Definite expiration date not exceeding **180 days**.
4. CISO executive approval for all HIGH or CRITICAL inherent risk items.

### Automatic Expiry Warnings:
Notifications will be dispatched at 30 days, 14 days, 7 days, and 1 day prior to expiration. If not renewed or remediated, tickets will automatically return to active review.
